narrative.overview:
Skew reads as a measured sheet. Poppins is the only typeface. The ground is sheet gray, panels are white, corners on those panels are 12px, and a 1px hairline separates a panel from the ground. Near-black ink does the reading and fills the primary button. Muted slate carries supporting text.

The strong color sits in the bias bar. The left share is red, the center share is the hairline gray, and the right share is blue. That blue is also the focus ring, the text-selection color, and the text-button hover. Buttons, chips, and the meter are pills. Panels sit flat. A small, medium, and large shadow scale is part of the system, and the sheet uses the small shadow on the round info pip over the card photograph.

The wordmark is Skew, set extrabold, with a smaller News mark in medium weight on the same baseline. The lockup carries the line “Balanced news coverage, powered by AI.” The ink footer repeats the lockup in white and footer gray and closes with “Stay consistent. Stay unbiased.”
keyCharacteristics: Sheet gray ground, white panels, a 1px hairline, and 12px panel corners
Near-black ink for reading text and the filled button
Full pills for buttons, chips, and the bias meter
Bias bar in left red, center hairline, and right blue
Flat panels, with a three-step shadow scale beside them

rules.name: The Bias Bar Rule
rules.body: The meter is three shares. Left is Bias Red (#b42318) with white labels. Center is the hairline (#e5e7eb) with ink labels. Right is Bias Blue (#1d4ed8) with white labels. Bias blue is also the 2px focus ring, the text-selection background, and the text-button hover. Bias red stays on the left share.

rules.name: The Ink Fill Rule
rules.body: The filled primary control is near-black ink with white type. Slate mute is for support, not for the primary action.

rules.name: The Poppins Rule
rules.body: Poppins is the only typeface. The loaded weights are 400, 500, 600, 700, and 800. There is no second family and no monospace role.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Skew is 40px extrabold, tracking -0.03em, line-height 1. News is 14px medium on the same baseline, 6px away, dropped 7px so the two marks align. On the ink footer, Skew is 22px and News is 11px, dropped 3px, in footer gray.

rules.name: The 1280 Rule
rules.body: Content lives in a 1280px container. The grid to follow is 12 columns with a 24px gutter and a 24px margin.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: A panel at rest is white, 12px, and 1px hairline, with no shadow. Do not promote the medium or large shadow onto resting panels. The article card itself is flat.

rules.name: The Pill Control Rule
rules.body: Buttons, chips, and the bias meter are full pills. Panels and photographs use 12px. The two radii do not swap.

rules.name: The Shared Disabled Rule
rules.body: Disabled buttons share one treatment: pressed gray fill, slate type, transparent border. Variant and outline do not survive the disabled state.

dos: Do set the page on sheet gray (#f6f6f6) with near-black ink (#00000f) in Poppins.
Do keep panels white, with a 12px corner, a 1px #e5e7eb border, and no resting shadow.
Do use the full pill radius (9999px) for buttons, chips, and the bias meter.
Do draw the bias meter as left red, center hairline, and right blue. The reference split on the sheet is 25 / 50 / 25.
Do set the wordmark as Skew in extrabold with the smaller News mark on the baseline.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, a monospace role, or a dark color scheme.
Don't place the small, medium, or large shadow on a resting panel.
Don't use the left bias red for button fills or page backgrounds.
Don't split the center share off the hairline. Both are #e5e7eb.
